title: Guide on sales tax exemption under Item 58A, Schedule A, Sales Tax (Persons Exempted from Payment of Tax) Order 2018 – bunker fuel (Version 2.0)
summary: Version 2.0 of RMCD's guide to the sales tax exemption for holders of a bunkering services permit (PDA 2) under the Petroleum Development Act 1974. Exempt goods: diesel, LNG, lubricating oil and greases (listed subheadings of 2710/2711) and B24 very low sulfur fuel oil (2710.20.00 00), bought from a registered manufacturer or brought from a special area, used solely as bunker fuel and delivered directly to eligible vessels: ships sailing from Malaysian ports to foreign ports, foreign ships on international voyages, international fishing boats, and ferries or cruise and tourist boats that call at foreign ports. Applications are manual (form at Appendix I, PDA 2 permit, CSA retail licence and the supplier's PO or proforma invoice) to the controlling customs station until MySST supports them; a CJ(P) Schedule A-58A report must be kept for every bunkering service, and sales tax becomes due if any condition is breached. Malay version only; RMCD doesn't list what changed from version 1.
replaces: Replaces the earlier version of the Item 58A guide (version 1; date not stated)
